changelog: Taste-driven discovery (opt-in): the engine pulls TMDB titles matched to each viewer instead of importing blindly - every external title on the home screen now has a traceable reason. New rows: You Might Like, Because You Watched X, Trending with a pinch of your taste, and What people are watching in your country. Adds a per-user taste profile, recommendation memory (stops re-surfacing titles you keep ignoring, with a cooldown that heals over time), and controlled exploration. For You is self-explaining even without an LLM. Richer taste signals: runtime length, maturity, language and franchise. Time-of-day recommendations now honor a configurable household time zone. Operational: behavior-event retention with bounded recompute, a bounded cache, and a new /Admin/Diagnostics endpoint. Enable it in the plugin settings (Taste-driven discovery) with a TMDB key; off by default.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
